newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian economy shows yr/yr growth in January.
newsitem.headline: Russian economy shows yr/yr growth in January.

text.p: Russian gross domestic product and industrial output were higher in January than a year earlier, the first time the economy has grown at the beginning of the year since reforms started, a senior official said on Friday.

GDP was 0.1 percent higher than a year earlier, while industrial output showed a 0.3 percent rise year-on-year, according to preliminary data from the State Statistics Committee made available to Reuters.
"It's the first time since reforms began that there's growth in January," Valery Galitsky, first deputy chairman of the committee, told Reuters.
Output has tended to decline steadily since economic reforms were launched in 1992, although there have been occasional one-off increases.
But the Russian economy traditionally contracts sharply in January, a month with many public holidays and in which cold winter weather can disrupt production.
